    Profile

    Mikoto is a priestess from Wadatsumi. Wadatsumi priestesses act as the voice of the Gods, so Mikoto possesses strong divine powers, as well as the ability to tell prophecy. Having spent so much time at her shrine and not having had much opportunity to interact with people, as a counter-reaction, she's developed a true love for chatting. If she ever has visitors and there's even a small chance to talk, she quickly turns into an ultra-chatterbox.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Female
    Height: 164cm
    Weight: 53kg
    Birthday: Mar 19
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Water Guardian
    Likes: Meal times (setting the table)
    Hobbies: Chatting (regardless with whom)
    Illust: てもし
    CV: 秦佐和子
